23.heading: every living substance:
refs: The most incontestable evidence has been afforded of the universality of this fact, the moose deer, a native of America, has been found buried in Ireland
elephants, native of Asia and Africa, in the midst of England
crocodiles, natives of the Nile, in the heart of Germany
and shell fish, never known in any but the American seas, with the entire skeletons of whales, in the most inland counties of England. Gen 7:21-22
23.body:
The most incontestable evidence has been afforded of the universality of this fact, the moose deer, a native of America, has been found buried in Ireland; elephants, native of Asia and Africa, in the midst of England; crocodiles, natives of the Nile, in the heart of Germany; and shell fish, never known in any but the American seas, with the entire skeletons of whales, in the most inland counties of England.
